neighbours.label: the piece 'ze' when the tokenizer cuts it off as its own token (Cru|ze, Je|ze|bel, Pl|zen, 'Deze' at the start of a line, the Dutch or Czech word ' ze', 'Ze' in Zeus); quiet when ze is merged into a bigger token (' bronze', ' freeze', ' dozen', ' Deze' after a space) or the letters split another way (z|ehn, Mend|ez, Gonz|alez, all-caps ' Z'+'E'); weak (~0.25) on whole words ending in -ze (' gaze', ' blaze', ' maze')
neighbours.short: the token piece 'ze' on its own
